primary_workload: huffman_decode --benchmark: decode 2048 independent canonical Huffman bitstreams of 65536 bytes each on GPU; time the kernel only (CUDA events)

acceptable_targets.description: Any modification to solve.cu that replaces the bit-by-bit decoder with an LUT-based approach achieving >= 5x speedup (median <= 11.2ms) while passing --verify correctness check

misdiagnosed_targets.note: Profiler shows high cudaMemcpy time, but this is a fixed cost (256 MB input, 128 MB output for 2048 streams); eliminating it entirely would save ~50ms API time but NOT the 56ms kernel time reported as time_ms.

misleading_counterfactual: Reducing HtoD/DtoH transfers does not affect the time_ms measurement (which uses CUDA events to time the kernel only, not the transfers). The kernel itself is the bottleneck.
